title: This Tank Was Full of Oil. It Wasn't. #Shorts
title_alternatives: The $180M Scam Hidden Under Salad Oil
He Borrowed $180M Against Tanks of Water
description:
In 1963, Tino De Angelis borrowed $180 million against tanks of "salad oil" that were mostly water.

How it worked: hidden compartments, the same oil piped from tank to tank, and 900,000 tons on paper vs 55,000 real. 51 lenders lost money. He pled guilty and served about 7 of a 20-year sentence.

Sources: Norman C. Miller, The Great Salad Oil Swindle (1965); Wikipedia: Salad oil scandal.

AI-narrated. Educational entertainment, not financial advice.
